hierarchical_sampling: sample data points hierarchically from a cluster hierarchy using random or closest-to-centroid strategy
random_selection: randomly select a fixed number of data points from each specified cluster
closest_to_centroid_selection: select data points closest to the centroid from each specified cluster
find_subcluster_target_size: compute target sample sizes for subclusters given an overall target size and multiplier
recursive_hierarchical_sampling: recursively sample points from a cluster at a given level in the hierarchy
